name: Try this here
summary: The few blocks around the poster drawn from above with a you-are-here dot; friends pin what to eat or do with a few words, Same makes a pin taller, and the poster taps one to draw a dotted walking route to it.
useWhen: in lima for 3 days what do i eat
what should i do around here tonight
having fun in south america eating tostadas, where next
first time in this city tell me where to go
dontUseWhen: a group choosing among a few places together (use claw-pick or slot-machine)
planning rides or who drives (use carpool)
a guessing game about where someone is (use guess-where)

author.description: Who posted and is asking for recs

place.description: Where they are, a city or neighbourhood

line.description: The post's own line, shown in quotes

water.description: Whether to draw water on one side (sea, river or lake)

recs.description: Recs already pinned: who, what in a few words, their note, kind, map spot in thousandths (the poster is at 500, 560) and who tapped Same
